name: exists_Ioo_extr_on_Icc
statement: a < b) (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) (hfI : f a = f b) : ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, IsExtrOn f (Icc a b) c

name: exists_isExtrOn_Ioo_of_tendsto
statement: a < b) (hfc : ContinuousOn f (Ioo a b)) (ha : Tendsto f (𝓝[>] a) (𝓝 l)) (hb : Tendsto f (𝓝[<] b) (𝓝 l)) : ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, IsExtrOn f (Ioo a b) c

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: EqOn (extendFrom (Ioo a b) f) f (Ioo a b)

name: exists_isExtrOn_uIoo_of_tendsto
statement: a ≠ b) (hfc : ContinuousOn f (uIoo a b)) (ha : Tendsto f (𝓝[uIoo a b] a) (𝓝 l)) (hb : Tendsto f (𝓝[uIoo a b] b) (𝓝 l)) : ∃ c ∈ uIoo a b, IsExtrOn f (uIoo a b) c

have_tree.name: h
have_tree.type: EqOn (extendFrom (uIoo a b) f) f (uIoo a b)
